name: Shan Shen Bu
blurb: One photo in: you do the viral Chinese flash step, the dodge, the kick, arms up and the low stance.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, body shape and outfit. They stand full-length on a narrow street in front of a small fruit shop, crates of oranges and grapes behind them, filmed on a phone held still at chest height, vertical 9:16, whole body in view from head to feet. (1) They stand still for a beat, arms by their sides, a dead-serious face. (2) The flash step: the torso snaps sharply sideways and back while the feet step out wide, twice, like dodging something. (3) They flick one knee up and kick the foot out to the side, arms swinging, then throw both arms up high with the hands open and shake. (4) They drop into a wide, low stance, knees bent, one arm out to the side, and hold it, chin up. Real dance timing, crisp and slightly comic, natural balance, one continuous shot, no cuts. Audio: a bouncy original folk-pop beat with a clap on every move. Exactly one person dancing, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
